native.independentEvidence: 12 complete before/after/relaunch/archive/export groups plus three legacy failure/retry controls. Original envelopes and all archived snapshot fields retained, connected export only, no new editing grant. Only knownTasks/quarantined Codable Set ordering normalized.
native.sharing: Actual JSON transfer data retained through reserved DEBUG inspection. iPhone/iPad native Save to Files action is observed and sharing cancelled. Mac native Save dialog writes the synthetic JSON to a temporary local folder; actual saved bytes equal the prepared export. A second Cancel preserves the file and workspace. No external delivery is claimed.
native.limits: Ordinary missing source and synthetic local peer on native hosts. Canonical recurring replacement and comment/cohort cases are Core-tested here, not broad new native series acceptance. Production account chooser, hosted receipt freshness/multiwriter, I/O-phase races, release/reinstall behavior and unsupported cross-table intent remain unaccepted.

storage.format: com.taskfold.saved-edits v1 export; encrypted TeamCompletionRecoveryDraft v1 private archive
storage.directory: Team drafts/<backend-bound ID>/Recorded recovery; separate from legacy Selections
storage.bounds: 20 explicit archives, 16 MB per plaintext archive, 64 MB aggregate ciphertext; no automatic eviction
storage.safety: Backup then account/backend-authenticated encrypted save and load verification before workspace persistence. Removal fence precedes the private lock. Same-work retry binds original envelope, complete review response and whole snapshot. Export does not include the full snapshot or analysis wrapper.
